study: Fancsali et al. 2015, RAISE / Reading Apprenticeship (WestEd SLI), Empirical Education i3 report
eval_evidence: Impact evaluation 'conducted by IMPAQ International and Empirical Education Inc.' (third-party evaluators); WestEd's SLI developed/delivered the PD but did not run the impact study.
developer_evidence: 'SLI staff and consultants provided Reading Apprenticeship' PD (65 hrs / 10 days via Springboard Institutes); the developer organization (WestEd SLI) delivered the core PD directly to teachers.
cascade_evidence: Core 65-hr PD delivered by SLI directly, but ongoing support ran through SLI-developed 'teacher leaders' (trained by SLI/state site coordinators) who facilitated monthly on-site team meetings -> a lead-teacher cascade for the support layer.
counterfactual_evidence: 'control schools conducted business as usual' while treatment schools received the 65-hr PD plus ongoing support; no active alternative PD for controls.
coaching_evidence: Ongoing support = monthly on-site team meetings led by a RAISE-trained teacher leader (collaboration, some coaching/mentoring/model-lessons); periodic group support, not recurring individual in-class coaching cycles.
student_dose_evidence: RAISE changes disciplinary teachers' instruction ('increased in-class opportunities for reading') within regular ELA/science/history classes; no tutoring, pull-out, or separate student dose.
maturity_evidence: Primary extracted wave = spring Year 2 (full 42-school sample after the complete 12-month PD dose); teachers had a prior implementation year (Year-1 results reported separately).
